items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: And Doc Severinsen used to say, “I think that way, I don’t think this way.”

ctx.x: Let me ask you about high notes. You have a way of talking about high notes are not necessarily higher, they’re farther away?

Right. And I learned that from Don Jacoby. You know it was interesting, Don Jacoby lived in Denton, Texas the last part of his life. And for 20 years every lead player in the One O’clock Band at North Texas had studied with Jake even though he wasn’t on faculty. They would just go to his house for separate lessons. And his philosophy was that up here, it was here and it was here — you can’t see my hand — but the air, the diaphragm. And that was it. Your mental attitude and the air that you use. And that was his…
